names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 22 martie, «Sfântul Cuvios Mucenic Eftimie».

death.note: doxologia.ro's life for him: «Sfântul Eftimie a fost ucis în amiaza zilei de 22 martie 1814, în Constantinopol».

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

feast.note: Doxologia keeps him twice: its calendar prints him on 22 martie, the day of his martyrdom, and again on 1 mai — «Sfântul Cuvios Mucenic Eftimie», beside the two other new-martyrs of the Holy Mountain, Ignatie and Acachie, whose relics the same day page names at Mănăstirea Neamţ. One attestation row per church is the schema, so the row is the day this folder was read from and the second day is recorded here. The 1 mai listing serves the same life this folder was written from, «Viața Sfântului Cuvios Mucenic Eftimie cel Nou», which gives 22 March 1814; the «1 Mai» in that page's head is therefore a real second commemoration and not a style conversion. Read 25 September 2026.

source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul zilei pentru 22 martie — «Sfântul Cuvios Mucenic Eftimie»
